issues.legal_issue: A civil suit for redemption is not barred by the one-year limitation period for setting aside an official order when the earlier summary application was rejected because the dispute required determination by a civil court, without deciding the right to redeem.
material_facts: The claimants applied to an official for summary redemption of a mortgage, and the application was rejected because the dispute raised complicated questions of fact and law that could not be tried in summary proceedings.
The official directed the claimants to file a civil suit and did not determine their entitlement to redeem the mortgage.
The claimants later brought a civil suit for redemption, and the mortgagees argued that it was barred because it had not been filed within one year of the rejection of the application.
issues.conclusion: The rejection did not have to be set aside and did not bar the civil suit for redemption; the one-year limitation period for suits to set aside official orders did not apply. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 4, 9 and 12 of the Redemption of Mortgages (Punjab) Act, 1913, an official may dismiss a summary redemption petition on specified grounds, and a party aggrieved by an order under Sections 6 to 11 may sue to establish rights in respect of the mortgage. Article 14 of Schedule I to the Limitation Act, 1908 applies to a suit seeking to set aside an official order, not to a suit for redemption where the official merely declines summary adjudication and leaves the parties to pursue their rights in civil court. An order must be one the officer had jurisdiction to make and one that bars relief unless set aside to require such a suit. The Court relied on Tulsi Das v. Diala Ram and Dewan Chand v. Raghbir Singh.

rule.if: civil_redemption_suit and prior_summary_redemption_application and official_referred_complex_dispute_to_civil_court and official_did_not_decide_redemption_rights

predicates.civil_redemption_suit: A person claiming a right to redeem brought a civil suit seeking redemption.
predicates.prior_summary_redemption_application: The person had previously applied to an official for summary redemption of the mortgage.
predicates.official_referred_complex_dispute_to_civ: The official rejected the summary application because the dispute was too complex for summary determination and directed the person to pursue a civil suit.
predicates.official_did_not_decide_redemption_right: The official did not determine whether the person was entitled to redeem the mortgage.

issues.definition: When a person brings a civil suit for redemption after an official has declined summary determination of a complex dispute without deciding the right to redeem, the suit is not barred by the prior order.
